capabilities.description: Exact/certified canonical identity of the active EntityInstance.
Declared behavioral boundary/interface representation in the certified scope.
Intrinsic relation graph/multigraph over the active entity organization.
Relation instances with exact declared relation/endpoint types.
Frozen action-labelled successor relation for the declared carrier/scope.
Which declared actions are currently legal.
Declared multiplicity of legal action copies when multiplicity is observable.
Certified construction/factor ancestry when explicitly observable for the Test; not behavioral state by default.
Graph-intrinsic path distance derived from certified relations; no geometric interpretation implied.
Automorphism/orbit information under the declared canonical structure.
Certified observer-relative quotient/classes for a frozen observer/action scope.

rule: Capabilities define typed readable structure only; they do not imply scientific interpretation. A Test must declare every capability it reads.
